newsitem.title: USA: Rust International to sell scaffolding business.
newsitem.headline: Rust International to sell scaffolding business.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc. said Wednesday its majority owned subsidiary, Rust International Inc., will sell its scaffolding business to DLJ Merchant Banking Partners LP and Carlisle Enterprises LP for about $190 million.
WMX, a major environmental services company, said the sale is expected to close in the third quarter.
Oak Brook, Ill.-based WMX provides comprehensive solid and hazardous waste services and clean water, clean energy and environmental consulting services.
WMX's stock fell 25 cents to $32.75 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
